title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:

You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox

title: Babies - Craft Welcome Baby Greeting Card_Floral-Pink
about: Use these printable to create truly one-of-a-kind artwork utilizing stamped or painted, finger and hand prints. Each print, painted and designed by Kristen Ley of Thimblepress® contains areas where your little one’s hand can be stamped on the print to create a custom bloom, or finger prints can be added by loved ones who want to celebrate the new child. A great way to involve loved ones is to have the print and a stamp pad at a baby shower, and for each attendee to stamp their print on it. Later, you can hang the print in the child’s room as a reminder of all the people who love and support the child.

title: Nature Journal Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Babies - Craft Welcome Baby Greeting Card_Floral-Pink
about: Use these printable to create truly one-of-a-kind artwork utilizing stamped or painted, finger and hand prints. This printable is a fun way to get your kids and loved ones involved in creating art for your little one. Each print, painted and designed by Kristen Ley of Thimblepress® contains areas where your little one’s hand can be stamped on the print to create a custom bloom, or finger prints can be added by loved ones who want to celebrate the new child. A great way to involve loved ones is to have the print and a stamp pad at a baby shower, and for each attendee to stamp their print on it. Later, you can hang the print in the child’s room as a reminder of all the people who love and support the child.

about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Babies - Craft Welcome Baby Greeting Card_Floral-Pink
about: Use these printable to create truly one-of-a-kind artwork utilizing stamped or painted, finger and hand prints. Each print, painted and designed by Kristen Ley of Thimblepress® contains areas where your little one’s hand can be stamped on the print to create a custom bloom, or finger prints can be added by loved ones who want to celebrate the new child. A great way to involve loved ones is to have the print and a stamp pad at a baby shower, and for each attendee to stamp their print on it. Later, you can hang the print in the child’s room as a reminder of all the people who love and support the child.

title: Babies - Craft Welcome Baby Greeting Card_Floral-Pink
about: Use these printable to create truly one-of-a-kind artwork utilizing stamped or painted, finger and hand prints. This printable is a fun way to get your kids and loved ones involved in creating art for your little one. Each print, painted and designed by Kristen Ley of Thimblepress® contains areas where your little one’s hand can be stamped on the print to create a custom bloom, or finger prints can be added by loved ones who want to celebrate the new child. A great way to involve loved ones is to have the print and a stamp pad at a baby shower, and for each attendee to stamp their print on it. Later, you can hang the print in the child’s room as a reminder of all the people who love and support the child.

title: Nature Journal Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Babies - Craft Welcome Baby Greeting Card_Floral-Pink
about: Use these printable to create truly one-of-a-kind artwork utilizing stamped or painted, finger and hand prints. This printable is a fun way to get your kids and loved ones involved in creating art for your little one. Each print, painted and designed by Kristen Ley of Thimblepress® contains areas where your little one’s hand can be stamped on the print to create a custom bloom, or finger prints can be added by loved ones who want to celebrate the new child. A great way to involve loved ones is to have the print and a stamp pad at a baby shower, and for each attendee to stamp their print on it. Later, you can hang the print in the child’s room as a reminder of all the people who love and support the child.

title: Nature Journal Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Nature Journal Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Nature Journal Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox

title: Nature Journal Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Nature Journal Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox

You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox

Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Babies - Craft Welcome Baby Greeting Card_Floral-Pink
about: Use these printable to create truly one-of-a-kind artwork utilizing stamped or painted, finger and hand prints. A great way to involve loved ones is to have the print and a stamp pad at a baby shower, and for each attendee to stamp their print on it. Later, you can hang the print in the child’s room as a reminder of all the people who love and support the child.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox

How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:

Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:

Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Babies - Craft Welcome Baby Greeting Card_Floral-Pink
about: Use these printable to create truly one-of-a-kind artwork utilizing stamped or painted, finger and hand prints. This printable is a fun way to get your kids and loved ones involved in creating art for your little one. Each print, painted and designed by Kristen Ley of Thimblepress® contains areas where your little one’s hand can be stamped on the print to create a custom bloom, or finger prints can be added by loved ones who want to celebrate the new child. A great way to involve loved ones is to have the print and a stamp pad at a baby shower, and for each attendee to stamp their print on it. Later, you can hang the print in the child’s room as a reminder of all the people who love and support the child.

title: Nature Journal Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Babies - Craft Welcome Baby Greeting Card_Floral-Pink
about: Use these printable to create truly one-of-a-kind artwork utilizing stamped or painted, finger and hand prints. This printable is a fun way to get your kids and loved ones involved in creating art for your little one. Each print, painted and designed by Kristen Ley of Thimblepress® contains areas where your little one’s hand can be stamped on the print to create a custom bloom, or finger prints can be added by loved ones who want to celebrate the new child. A great way to involve loved ones is to have the print and a stamp pad at a baby shower, and for each attendee to stamp their print on it. Later, you can hang the print in the child’s room as a reminder of all the people who love and support the child.

title: Babies - Craft Welcome Baby Greeting Card_Floral-Pink
about: Use these printable to create truly one-of-a-kind artwork utilizing stamped or painted, finger and hand prints. This printable is a fun way to get your kids and loved ones involved in creating art for your little one. Each print, painted and designed by Kristen Ley of Thimblepress® contains areas where your little one’s hand can be stamped on the print to create a custom bloom, or finger prints can be added by loved ones who want to celebrate the new child. A great way to involve loved ones is to have the print and a stamp pad at a baby shower, and for each attendee to stamp their print on it. Later, you can hang the print in the child’s room as a reminder of all the people who love and support the child.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:

Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Nature Journal Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Babies - Craft Welcome Baby Greeting Card_Floral-Pink
about: Use these printable to create truly one-of-a-kind artwork utilizing stamped or painted, finger and hand prints. This printable is a fun way to get your kids and loved ones involved in creating art for your little one. Each print, painted and designed by Kristen Ley of Thimblepress® contains areas where your little one’s hand can be stamped on the print to create a custom bloom, or finger prints can be added by loved ones who want to celebrate the new child. A great way to involve loved ones is to have the print and a stamp pad at a baby shower, and for each attendee to stamp their print on it. Later, you can hang the print in the child’s room as a reminder of all the people who love and support the child.

title: Nature Journal Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Nature Journal Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Snagging Slithering Snakes with Sam
Conservation Biologist, Sam Wynns joins Curiosity Camp this week to tell us all about her love for snakes, protecting ecosystems from extinction (super important!) and the tools she uses to do her job. You also get to meet Sam’s very cool friend, Wilson (psst he’s a snake).

title: Recycled Plant Paper Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Yes, kids can help with climate change!
In this campisode, scientist Kimberley Miner answers YOUR questions about climate change, how the changes going on in the world can affect you & how YOU can help with climate change.

title: Solar Print Fabric Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
This Astrophysicist Sends Satellites Tied to a Rocket to Study the Sun
As an Astrophysicist, Kelly works on satellites that are attached to rockets that are sent up to space to study the Sun. While watching this, you’ll learn about how Kelly’s fascination in the Sun led to her studying astrophysics and how a speaking engagement (that she wasn’t going to go to!) got her the job of a lifetime!

title: Paper Beads Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Did You Know that Numbers Can Help Save Lives Around the World?
Learn how numbers can help save people including children around the world from Human Rights Statistician Davina Durgana. You’ll also get to meet her pup, Juno!

title: Galaxy Rocks Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Are There Really Aliens Out There?!
Space Professional, Dana Bolles has faced some obstacles but it has never stopped her from going after her dreams!
Making her dreams come true, Dana works for the biggest space agency and manages the payloads and makes sure everything is safe for launch. She’s also working on a project that is exploring other life on other planets!

title: Beaded Spiders Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Hanging Out with Creepy Crawlies!
Ronda Hamm probably has one of the creepiest jobs you can think of...well, she is an entomologist! Working with creepy crawlies like spiders and bugs, Ronda studies insects so she can teach folks like ourselves more about them.
Ronda started out her career by studying ants and figuring out how to get them to help plants. As she continued to learn, she also started inventing and she worked with her team on a bed bug detector!

title: Bottled Ocean Waves Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Learn all About Ocean Exploration from Expedition Leader Allison Fundis
In this campisode, ocean wildlife from expedition leader Allison shares how she researches undiscovered ocean wildlife and how her and her team work together to map the ocean for shipwrecks, lost planes and more! You’ll even learn about the cool robotic vehicles that go to the depths of the ocean to search for new species.

title: DIY DIno Dig Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Digging Up Fossils!
Welcome to campisode 1 of Cool Tools! This episode features our guide and talented Paleontologist, Myria Perez. Myria dives into her job as a paleontologist, talks about some uber cool tools she uses while on the job, and even takes you through an experiment... that may or may not involve bones and perhaps some cookies. 🍪 Enjoy!

title: Salt Crystal Tree Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
Save Animals from Pollution!
USDA Ecologist, Lindsey Rustad has been fighting to save animals’ environments since she was a little girl. From helping clean up litter to finding ways to get rid of the pollution in the beaches, Lindsey’s mission has always been to help animals.
Now as a USDA Ecologist, Lindsey conducts climate change experiments in the forest to help all the plants/trees and animals.

title: Whale Tail Bookmark Learning Worksheet Goldieblox
about:
How Can Coding Save Orca Whales?
In this episode of Cool Tools, Gracie Ermi-- a Research Software Engineer at Vulcan-- takes you into the world of A.I. Gracie's job allows her to help save animals by creating coding thats used to measure the health of orcas. Amazing, right? Watch the full episode to learn more about Gracie's job and how much of a difference it makes!

title: Babies - Craft Welcome Baby Greeting Card_Floral-Pink
about: Use these printable to create truly one-of-a-kind artwork utilizing stamped or painted, finger and hand prints. This printable is a fun way to get your kids and loved ones involved in creating art for your little one. Each print, painted and designed by Kristen Ley of Thimblepress® contains areas where your little one’s hand can be stamped on the print to create a custom bloom, or finger prints can be added by loved ones who want to celebrate the new child. A great way to involve loved ones is to have the print and a stamp pad at a baby shower, and for each attendee to stamp their print on it. Later, you can hang the print in the child’s room as a reminder of all the people who love and support the child.
